purpose: Teach: 目黒/野中/渡部/三宅/酒井/武部/高野/久保田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、目黒の小さな店舗から始められた
lines.en: Your father — he started from that small shop in Meguro when he founded the company.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering tone. Quiet authority of someone recalling pivotal moments. Measured pace, settling on each person's name like placing a stone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは野中氏を初代主任として任命された
lines.en: Yes. My father appointed Nonaka-san as the first supervisor.
lines.style: Composed, affirming. Respectful nod in the voice. Clear but not sharp — honoring the past without performing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、渡部氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And in his younger days, he planned the overseas expansion with Watanabe-san.
lines.style: Soft wonder underneath. Slight upward lift at the memory — affection for the boldness of youth. Unhurried, like turning pages.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは三宅氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. My father made Miyake-san the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Steady, almost ceremonial. Weight on 「柱に据える」 — the importance of placing the right person. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、酒井氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: In those years, he built the accounting infrastructure with Sakai-san.
lines.style: Same gentle reverie as before. Recognizing the unglamorous, essential work. Fond, acknowledging the foundation beneath everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは武部氏に工場長を任された
lines.en: Yes. My father entrusted Takebe-san with the role of factory director.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. The word 「任す」 carries trust — not casual, deliberate. Grounded, present moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、高野氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And with Takano-san, he established the overseas subsidiary.
lines.style: Returning to that tender, remembering tone. A lifetime of partnership compressed into a single line. Slow, honoring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは久保田氏に技術部全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. My father entrusted Kubota-san with the entire technology division.
lines.style: Final affirmation — quieter, more inward. The completion of a portrait. Breath of closure, not ending abruptly. Grave and warm.
